{"merchant":null,"receipt_number":null,"date":null,"time":null,"currency":null,"items":[{"description":null,"quantity":null,"unit_price":null,"line_total":null}],"subtotal":null,"discount":null,"tax":null,"total":null}

Merchant: printed header company/business name, otherwise store/branch name; never infer from logos or websites. Receipt number: prefer Bill/Invoice/Receipt, then Check/CHK, then transaction/order ID; exclude terminal, table, payment and unlabeled barcode numbers. Use transaction date/time, retaining printed separators and AM/PM.

Items: one row per priced purchase/add-on; append unpriced product modifiers to its description. Exclude promotion, discount, tax and payment lines. Copy unit_price only from a separate printed unit-price field; a lone amount is line_total. Preserve item order.

Total: primary final sale amount, not alternate-currency conversion, payment, change or balance. Currency must explicitly apply to that primary amount. Subtotal, discount and tax: printed receipt-wide summary amounts only, not item-level adjustments or percentages. Do not calculate. Omit currency from amount strings; preserve signs and separators.

Preserve other text and capitalization; join field line breaks with spaces. Use strings, null for missing/unreadable fields, and [] for no items. Include every key. Do not infer missing text, translate or add explanations/Markdown.

Recipient fields come from 支払を受ける者; payer fields come from 支払者. Map amounts to 支払金額, 給与所得控除後の金額, 所得控除の額の合計額 and 源泉徴収税額 respectively.
